from.place: Proof, first paragraph, right unit: "the fact that braiding with the monoidal unit is the unitor identification".

title: Braiding with the monoidal unit
statement:
Let $(\mathcal C,\otimes,\mathbf 1)$ be a monoidal category with left unitor $\lambda_X:\mathbf 1\otimes X\to X$ and right unitor $\varrho_X:X\otimes\mathbf 1\to X$ (notation as in [det-def-sfb-ring-object-monoid]) and braiding $\beta$. For every object $X$,
$$\lambda_X\circ\beta_{X,\mathbf 1}=\varrho_X.$$
